title: The Sandman
subtitle: Fantasy TV Show
overview: After years of imprisonment, Morpheus — the King of Dreams — embarks on a journey across worlds to find what was stolen from him and restore his power.

episodes.title: Sleep of the Just
episodes.overview: While searching for an escaped nightmare in the waking world, Morpheus falls prey to Roderick Burgess, an occultist looking to summon Death.

episodes.title: Imperfect Hosts
episodes.overview: Morpheus begins his quest to find his tools of power by visiting a pair of notoriously dysfunctional brothers: Cain and Abel.

episodes.title: Dream a Little Dream of Me
episodes.overview: Morpheus tracks down the last known person in possession of his sand: Johanna Constantine. An unconventional exorcism follows.

episodes.title: A Hope in Hell
episodes.overview: A lead on his helm takes Morpheus to Hell, where he meets Lucifer Morningstar. John Dee's pursuit of the ruby turns deadly.
With Morpheus incapacitated, John camps out at a diner to observe the patrons as they spiral into madness and deceit.

episodes.title: The Sound of Her Wings
episodes.overview: Feeling directionless after reclaiming his tools, Morpheus accompanies his busy sister, Death. Flashbacks recount his friendship with an immortal man.

episodes.title: The Doll's House
episodes.overview: Lucienne shares alarming news with Morpheus. Rose Walker sets out in search of her missing brother.

episodes.title: Playing House
episodes.overview: As Morpheus closes in on one of his missing creations, Rose ramps up her efforts to locate Jed.

episodes.title: Collectors
episodes.overview: Strange disturbances ripple through the Dreaming. Rose's friends begin to vanish as the Corinthian's convention gets underway.

episodes.title: Lost Hearts
episodes.overview: The Dream Vortex grows ever more powerful. As the boundaries between worlds weaken, Morpheus must make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: A Dream of a Thousand Cats / Calliope
episodes.overview: A siamese cat dreaming of a new world, and a writer in desperate need of inspiration, cross paths with Morpheus.

episodes.title: Season of Mists
episodes.overview: Lucifer makes a shocking surrender, giving Morpheus the key to the gates of Hell and sparking a cosmic scramble.

episodes.title: Brief Lives
episodes.overview: Delirium convinces Morpheus to accompany her on a search across the waking realm for their long-lost brother, Destruction.

episodes.title: The Song of Orpheus
episodes.overview: Morpheus must confront an ancient tragic debt to his son Orpheus in order to gain vital divine sight.

episodes.title: Fables & Reflections
episodes.overview: Four divergent tales illuminate hidden corners of the Endless across history and forgotten kingdoms.

episodes.title: Worlds' End
episodes.overview: Travelers stranded by a reality storm gather at a mysterious cosmic tavern to swap astonishing tales of survival.

episodes.title: The Kindly Ones
episodes.overview: A desperate quest for vengeance unleashes the ancient Furies against the Dreaming in an ultimate showdown.

title: Silo
subtitle: Sci-Fi
overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts uncovering shocking secrets.

episodes.title: Freedom Day
episodes.overview: Sheriff Becker makes a fateful choice after his wife believes she discovered the truth about the Silo.

episodes.title: Holston's Pick
episodes.overview: Juliette looks into the death of a coworker while Becker decides who should succeed him as sheriff.

episodes.title: Machines
episodes.overview: In her hunt for a new sheriff, Mayor Jahns clashes with Bernard. Juliette makes a deal to keep the generator running.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.overview: Bernard approaches Juliette with a proposition. Meanwhile, Juliette seeks out an eccentric friend in Mechanical.

episodes.title: The Janitor's Boy
episodes.overview: Sims appoints Billings as chief deputy to keep tabs on Juliette, whose efforts to solve two murders lead to a standoff.

episodes.title: The Outside
episodes.overview: Juliette navigates the eerie desolation of the toxic exterior and discovers a neighboring silo that holds answers.

episodes.title: Order
episodes.overview: Tensions within the Silo ignite into open rebellion as Bernard attempts to contain the truth of Juliette's survival.

episodes.title: The Shift
episodes.overview: A flashback reveals the founding fathers' secret archives and the original protocol for cleaning day.

episodes.title: The Dive
episodes.overview: Juliette dives into the submerged lower vault of the ruined silo to recover essential life support machinery.

episodes.title: Remains
episodes.overview: Juliette reaches out across radio frequencies and makes contact with an unexpected survivor.

title: Big Buck Bunny
subtitle: Recently Added
overview: A large and lovable rabbit deals with forest bullies in an epic showdown. Watch the classic open animated short film.

title: Sintel
subtitle: Recently Added
overview: A lonely young woman embarks on a dangerous and emotional quest across desolate lands to rescue her companion dragon.

title: Tears of Steel
subtitle: Sci-Fi
overview: In a dystopian Amsterdam, a group of scientists attempts to alter past memories to stop a rogue robotics uprising.

title: Elephants Dream
subtitle: Surreal
overview: Two wanderers journey through an intricate, surreal mechanical world governed by winding machines and hidden architecture.
